# Charlotta & Lavendar Lewis

- [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) — Commands — [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) — employer/master to handmaiden · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> At school, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) gets into a dispute over a picture drawn on a slate, while [Dora](../character/dora.md) becomes frightened of staying in the dark after [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) shares stories of her family's ghosts. Later in October, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) get lost in the woods on their way to a tea party and stumble upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). There they meet the eccentric Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her maid [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), who invite them to stay for tea.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)_

> Miss Lavendar entertains [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and Charlotta the Fourth with tea and demonstrates the magical echoes around [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). After explaining the history of her succession of 'Charlottas,' Miss Lavendar is shaken when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) casually mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), the son of her former lover, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). The girls bid a warm farewell to a visibly saddened Miss Lavendar and reflect on her and their own names as they leave.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P87](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0087)_

> At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dresses up to visit Miss Lavendar, leading to a humorous dinner conversation with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), and [Dora](../character/dora.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) walk to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they enjoy lunch, test the echoes, and chat in the garden with Miss Lavendar and Charlotta the Fourth.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031)_

> While picking berries, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) confides her worries about Miss Lavendar's melancholic mood to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to plan an extended visit during her vacation to cheer her up. After returning to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for tea, Miss Lavendar and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) share a tender conversation about their shared imagination and dream-people before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) depart.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P62](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0062)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and helps Miss Lavendar make a new dress before visiting [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). There, she meets Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), who asks her to carry a message to Miss Lavendar about visiting her. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers the note and helps an excited Miss Lavendar prepare for Stephen's arrival.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P17](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0017), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057)_

> [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) arrives at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss Lavendar. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) greets him on the porch and ushers him into the parlor to meet Miss Lavendar. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) spot Stephen and Miss Lavendar walking together affectionately in the garden, confirming their joyful reconciliation.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P64](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0064), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P71](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0071)_

> Miss Lavendar and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) are married at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) in a lovely ceremony attended by their friends. After seeing the newlyweds off, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) finish tidying the house, where a brief romantic spark between them hints at the changing chapter of Anne's life.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House
